data.value:
Welcome to Project Advisor Hub!
This application is designed to simplify and streamline the process of managing final-year projects. It connects students, advisors, and administrators in one unified platform. Students can track their projects, collaborate with group members, and share files with advisors. Advisors can evaluate submissions, assign grades, and guide multiple groups. Admins oversee the entire system, managing users, projects, and assignments. Together, these features create a modern, efficient, and transparent project management experience.
